[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-2w[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Cancel tasks with an optional reason from the Ctrl+Shift+P picker[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Obsidian, Ctrl+Shift+P on a #task line (bare or counted) or on a[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dedicated Task Link offers a pinned Cancel row. It asks for an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]optional reason, then closes the task(s) as Cancelled `[-]` with a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`\[cancelled:: YYYY-MM-DD]` stamp and records the reason under a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]managed `❌ **CANCEL LOG**` child. It also removes the tasks' links[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from today's open Pomodoros, unblocks their dependents right away, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and confirms with a rich notice card.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Task Status Cycler: versioned dependent-recovery API and [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]cancelled-link guard[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]tsc-recovery-api[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tsc-recovery-api: expose `api.recoverBlockedDependents` (version 1) from[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task-status-cycler. Keep a dependent Blocked while it has a strictly [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]future `scheduled` date. When Ctrl+Enter lands on a Task Link to a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Cancelled task, show a notice instead of completing the owning Pomodoro.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Bump the version, update the README, add tests, and sync to the vault.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Navigation Hotkeys: Cancel Log grammar and pure cancel planner[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cancel-planner[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cancel-planner: add the `❌ **CANCEL LOG**` marker/entry grammar, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`cancel` managed-log kind (so project conversion carries the log), and a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pure batch planner. The planner sets `[-]`, upserts `\[cancelled::]`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]writes the Cancel Log first-child/prepend/fallback entry, refuses [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recurring tasks, and returns the cancelled identities. Export the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]helpers and unit-test them. No UI yet.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]sessions. Commit through the existing guarded editor and cross-note [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]API, show the Cancelled notice card, add CSS, bump the version, update [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the README, add tests, and sync.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
